'''M4-Y8''' was a small [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]].

==Behind the scenes==
The M4-Y8 Astromech Droid was a gift given to all players through their mailbox in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a gift for Star Wars Day on [[May 4]], [[2019]]. "M4-Y8" stands for May 4 of Year 8.<ref name="May4">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20190430|text=Celebrate May the 4th!}}</ref>
